exposure: type of birth (vaginal, elective cesarean section)
outcome: child psychological development (cognitive, language, motor, socio-emotional, adaptive behavior domains)
cohort: The study included 263 Brazilian children up to 42 months of age from Sao Bernardo do Campo, Sao Paulo.
finding: This research indicates potential impairments in the psychological development of children born at early term via elective cesarean.
mod_finding: Children born via elective cesarean section showed greater impairment in sensory processing and adaptive behavior compared to those born vaginally.
